# Pure Labs Pay

> Payment processing for nutra, peptide and kratom brands that want to stay processing.

Pure Labs Pay provides merchant accounts and card processing for lab and wellness commerce.
Processing is delivered through partner acquiring banks. Pure Labs Pay is not a bank and not an
acquirer.

## Categories and status

- Nutra and supplements: live. Established supplement, vitamin, sports nutrition, herbal,
  functional food and beauty supplement brands can apply today.
- Peptides: opening soon. A priority list is open. Research use and licensed telehealth or
  compounding models.
- Kratom: opening soon, United States only, in supported states. A priority list is open. Leaf,
  powder and capsule products.

## Markets

- United States and Canada first.
- Other countries possible on review.
- Kratom is United States only, and not available in every state. The current list of states we
  do not support is published at /legal/restricted-regions.html.
- Kratom is not available for merchants based in or selling to Canada.

## What we do not process

- Products with disease or drug claims
- Prescription-only ingredients
- Ingredients banned by the FDA or Health Canada
- Concentrated or synthetic 7-OH products
- Human-use claims on research peptides

The full list is published at /legal/acceptable-use.html.

## How to apply

1. Share your recent processing statements along with your business details at /apply.html.
2. Underwriting reviews your history and comes back with a custom rate.
3. You see every term before you sign, and we help you plan the move from your current processor.

Pricing is built around each merchant's own processing history, so no rates, fees, reserves or
contract terms are published on this site or in this file. Every term is shown in writing before
signing.
